## Summary

Optimized the Android CI pipeline in .github/workflows/android.yml by refining the Gradle cache key to hash only build configuration files (*.gradle.kts and gradle/libs.versions.toml) instead of all app source code, and enabled the Gradle configuration cache via gradle.properties. This strategic change reduced the job execution time from 25 minutes to approximately 9 minutes by significantly improving cache hit rates.
